module_summary: PTP hardware clock: a per-cycle increment computed from period, offset-adjust and drift registers accumulates into 96-bit (s/ns/fns with 1e9 overflow lookahead) and 64-bit timestamp registers, loadable from inputs, also producing step and PPS pulses.

anchors.name: ts_96_s_reg
anchors.why: Seconds field of 96-bit time-of-day, incremented on ns overflow or loaded

anchors.name: ts_96_ns_reg
anchors.why: Nanoseconds field of 96-bit timestamp output

anchors.name: ts_96_ns_inc_reg
anchors.why: Accumulator adding per-cycle increment to nanoseconds

anchors.name: ts_96_ns_ovf_reg
anchors.why: Overflow lookahead; sign bit triggers seconds increment and PPS

anchors.name: ts_64_ns_reg
anchors.why: 64-bit relative nanosecond timestamp accumulator

anchors.name: ts_inc_ns_reg
anchors.why: Per-cycle time increment: period plus active offset adjust plus drift

anchors.name: ts_inc_ns_delay_reg
anchors.why: Delayed increment aligned with overflow lookahead pipeline

anchors.name: ts_inc_ns_ovf_reg
anchors.why: 1e9 minus increment, used for overflow lookahead subtraction

anchors.name: period_ns_reg
anchors.why: Programmable nominal clock period, loaded on input_period_valid

anchors.name: adj_ns_reg
anchors.why: Offset adjustment amount added while adjustment is active

anchors.name: adj_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts remaining offset-adjust cycles, drives adj_active_reg

anchors.name: adj_active_reg
anchors.why: Enables offset adjustment term in increment computation

anchors.name: drift_ns_reg
anchors.why: Drift compensation amount added every drift_rate cycles

anchors.name: drift_rate_reg
anchors.why: Drift application interval reloading drift_cnt

anchors.name: drift_cnt
anchors.why: Down counter gating when drift term is applied

anchors.name: ts_step_reg
anchors.why: Pulses when timestamp is loaded or offset adjusted

anchors.name: pps_reg
anchors.why: One-pulse-per-second tick from seconds overflow

anchors.name: input_ts_96
anchors.why: 96-bit timestamp to load into time-of-day registers

anchors.name: input_ts_96_valid
anchors.why: Load enable for 96-bit timestamp

anchors.name: input_ts_64
anchors.why: 64-bit timestamp to load

anchors.name: output_ts_96
anchors.why: 96-bit time-of-day timestamp output

anchors.name: output_ts_64
anchors.why: 64-bit relative timestamp output

anchors.name: output_pps
anchors.why: Pulse-per-second output

anchors.name: output_ts_step
anchors.why: Indicates non-monotonic timestamp step

groups.name: Increment computation
groups.description: Sums period, offset and drift into per-cycle increment and lookahead constant

groups.name: 96-bit time-of-day counter
groups.description: Seconds/ns/fns accumulator with 1e9 overflow lookahead and PPS

groups.name: Adjustment registers
groups.description: Period, offset-adjust and drift configuration with counters

groups.name: Timestamp I/O
groups.description: Timestamp load inputs and timestamp/PPS outputs
